column1: # Curated comet osculating-element snapshot for the V-49 comet layer.
# Source: JPL Small-Body Database (SBDB)
#   retrieved 2025-01 for the listed objects. Elements are heliocentric
#   osculating Keplerian elements referred to the J2000.0 ecliptic and equinox
#   in the Marsden / Minor Planet Center convention. Public-domain US
#   Government data (NASA/JPL). See DATA_SOURCES.md and data/manifest.toml
#   (id "jpl-sbdb-comet-elements-2025-01").
# Two-body Keplerian propagation from the time of perihelion passage Tp is
# accurate to ~arcminutes near each element epoch; the N-body upgrade is
# tracked under L-06. Coma photometry uses the Bobrovnikoff-Bowell magnitude
# law m1 = M1 + 5 log10(delta) + K1 log10(r). The M1 / K1 values are
# representative visual-total-magnitude coefficients for naked-eye rendering.
# Columns:
#   name              display name
#   q_au              perihelion distance (AU)
#   e                 eccentricity
#   i_deg             inclination to the J2000 ecliptic (deg)
#   arg_peri_deg      argument of perihelion omega (deg)
#   long_node_deg     longitude of ascending node Omega (deg)
#   tp_jd_tt          time of perihelion passage (TT Julian Date)
#   m1                absolute total magnitude M1
#   k1                activity slope K1 (= 2.5 n)
